name: Emergency grab bag
pitch: Build a checklist of documents, medicines and contacts for a family evacuation.
instructions: Start by asking the person how many people are in the family and if any have special medical needs. When the numbers are known, make a new page titled "Family emergency grab bag". Add a table with three columns: "Item", "Who", "Notes". Fill the first rows with the core categories: identification documents, health insurance cards, prescription medicines, a small first-aid kit, contact list, cash and a phone charger. For each row, ask the person to fill in the name of who should carry each item. When a category has no specific item, leave the cell blank and add a note such as "check with [name]". After the table, add a plain‑text section: "Important documents – keep copies in a waterproof bag". List the documents the person should check: passport, birth certificate, driving licence, insurance policy. Below that, add a contacts section with columns "Name" and "Phone". Ask the person to add at least two emergency contacts who live outside the home. Save the page to the workspace with file_write. If the person says they do not know what documents to include, say: "I could not find a standard list for your family size. Ask a local council or Red Cross for a template." If any step finds no response after two attempts, stop and ask the person to clarify the missing information.

rules.name: ask before writing

readme:
# Emergency grab bag
Create a checklist of documents, medicines and contacts for a family evacuation.

- Needs: make_page, show_table, memory_remember, file_write.
- Will not generate a completed checklist without the person’s input.
- Will ask for confirmation before saving the file.
